questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

Statements:

All leaves are plants.

All plants are trees.

All trees are big.

Conclusions:

I. Some trees are leaves.

II. All leaves are big.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7875563429660f285e09d59a42d943a3b102632df9dc3e06cd335c208ef8ee42.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trees are leaves. → **Follows **(As, All leaves are plants and All plants are trees, so some part of trees are also leaves)

II. All leaves are big. → **Follows** (As, All leaves are plants, All plants are trees and All trees are big, so all leaves are big)

Hence, '**Both conclusions I and II follow**' is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)

(264, 43, 19)

(132, 27, 15)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (Second number - Third number) × 11 = First number

 
• (264, 43, 19) → (43 - 19) × 11 = 24 × 11 = 264
 
• (132, 27, 15) → (27 - 15) × 11 = 12 × 11 = 132

Similarly,

 
• (176, 39, 23) → (39 - 23) × 11 = 16 × 11 = 176

Hence, '**(176, 39, 23)**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which option represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in the English dictionary ?

1. Difficult

2. Differentiate

3. Dissolve

4. Dilute

5. Distance
questions.solution:
The option which represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in the English dictionary is:

2. **Diffe**rentiate

1. **Diffi**cult

4. **Dil**ute

3. **Diss**olve

5. **Dist**ance

Hence, '**2, 1, 4, 3, 5**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven people Q, R, Y, W, T, E, and U are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of R. U sits at the extreme right. Seven people **Q, R, Y, W, T, E, and U** are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1. U sits at the extreme right.

2. Only three people sit to the left of R.
